decisions.rule: Small/Medium/Large is automated from ordered net value; Good/Bad is manually tagged by the sales team.
Implement trial first, evaluate for 14 days, then upgrade if performance is satisfactory.
Do not use neonmonki.com or neonmonki.team for bulk newsletter marketing; use a separate warmed domain.
Microsoft Clarity selected as primary behavior analytics tool; Lucky Orange no longer required if Clarity covers needs.
B2B resellers and direct B2B customers require separate treatment; resellers need careful, relationship-first communication.
Questions can go directly to Salesforce; any technical change/task must first be explained to Adika for scope, complexity and pricing approval.
Any existing customer or company with prior touchpoint should be excluded from cold outreach and moved to appropriate warm/newsletter communication.
Budget scaling is a 15-day capacity stress test; maximize realistic lead outcome and assess operational capacity, not only ad metrics.
Preferred test window is September 1-15 to reduce holiday-season distortion.
Start with an organized shared task sheet before paying for expensive task-management software.
Use a practical NEONMONKI configurator prototype as evidence of Taimoor's capability; candidate should propose timeline and resource needs.
